name: triage-ai
description: Triage AI MVP: product console for fast incident analysis and response.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @triage-ai/api" "npm run dev --workspace @triage-ai/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @triage-ai/shared && npm run build --workspace @triage-ai/api && npm run build --workspace @triage-ai/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @triage-ai/api && npm run test --workspace @triage-ai/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @triage-ai/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @triage-ai/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @triage-ai/web
